task_context:
Code quality review of a focused additive change. Repo: /home/jpoimboe/imp.
DESCRIPTION: Task 14 — additively add `_responses_tool_schema` (flat function-tool entry) and `_imp_to_responses_input` (imp Message[] → Responses input[] items) to openai.py, alongside the still-live Chat Completions helpers. Part of the additive-then-flip migration (flip is Task 17).
Assess:
- Correctness of the conversion logic: assistant text+tool_use ordering (text item emitted before function_call items — matches how a real assistant turn is structured); error prefix on tool_result; json.dumps of input; skipping system messages (carried via instructions at the call site).
- Clarity: docstrings accurately describe the mapping; naming parallels the old helpers (`_imp_to_responses_input` vs `_imp_to_openai_messages`).
- Reuse: leverages existing `_join_text` / `to_openai_strict` rather than duplicating.
- Tests verify real behavior. Any Minor gaps (e.g. system-message skip not tested; multi-tool-call turn; empty-text assistant turn)?
- Anything unnecessary/over-engineered. This is additive scaffolding that becomes live in Task 17.
Return: Strengths; Issues tagged (Critical/Important/Minor); Assessment (APPROVED or CHANGES REQUESTED). If clean, APPROVED.
